sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
MarketsandMarkets is a growth-enabling firm founded in 2009 that provides market research reports, AI-powered strategic intelligence, and business consulting services to B2B companies.

Industry: Market Research & Business Consulting · Size: 1000-4999 · Products: GrowthIQ, SalesPlay, KnowledgeStore, Market Research Reports, Growth Advisory Programs, Knowledge Services

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: MarketsandMarkets scores 22 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by company size (12/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: No close match to a reference account. This lead stands on its own ICP fit rather than on resemblance to a known win.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
